replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
This is the right forums section. Your map doesn't really look good.

I suggest replacing the dirt with mycelium, turn the biome into the "Sky" biome with its dark sky, and use dark castle materials like some nether brick with some cracked and mossy stone brick, expand the castle's size, and add some terraforming like mountains and hills and rivers of lava!

I can see that this can be promising. But you need to have more details.

The dirt is flat, make terrain, and paint it so it isn't just plain dirt. I will make a detailed post about how to detail, and build with depth.
Just add some detail and I can see it turning out great :) Keep up the work!
